scope.sourcePolicy: Official per-major PostgreSQL application documentation, stable-branch source parser/option table, security advisories, and release notes.

output.stdout: default upstream destination; PgCliSharp exposes binary-safe Stream even though content is SQL text/selected encoding
output.file: --file lets pg_dumpall write its file and perform its own sync behavior
output.nestedPgDump: pg_dumpall locates pg_dump in the same directory and requires the exact same PostgreSQL version before dumping databases

connection.dbname: --dbname is a libpq connection string; database name inside it is ignored because pg_dumpall connects to many databases
connection.initialDatabase: -l/--database chooses the initial database for globals/discovery; otherwise upstream tries postgres then template1
connection.precedence: connection-string parameters override conflicting individual command-line connection parameters according to upstream/libpq behavior

environments.encodingAlternative: PGCLIENTENCODING/libpq behavior can affect connections; --encoding explicitly sets dump output encoding from PostgreSQL 11+
environments.inherited: libpq environment variables apply. Passwords should use libpq password mechanisms and are never rendered into PgCliSharp command diagnostics.

validationRules.require: GlobalsOnly, RolesOnly, and TablespacesOnly are mutually exclusive and represented as one enum
database exclusion patterns/filter database exclusions cannot be combined with globals/roles/tablespaces-only scopes
ASCII alphanumeric and exact executable version at/after security-backport boundary
at most one stdin filter stream is bound by PgCliSharp
data-only/schema-only/statistics-only and statistics/no-statistics conflicts mirror nested pg_dump semantics

inventoryVerification.method: Compared resolved long-option spellings with REL_10_STABLE through REL_18_STABLE src/bin/pg_dump/pg_dumpall.c long_options[]; utility --help/--version handled separately because source recognizes them before getopt.
inventoryVerification.result: Exact source-table inventory captured for all majors; no unexplained source/spec options remain.
noteworthyParserFindings: --dbname is a connection string while -l/--database is the initial database.
pg_dumpall requires a same-version sibling pg_dump executable.
--no-acl and --attribute-inserts are aliases; canonical wrapper spellings are --no-privileges and --column-inserts.
PG17 filter supports only exclude database entries.
Output is always SQL script; stdout is upstream default.

sourceLevelVerification.result: Complete option-table and hard-validation audit performed across REL_10_STABLE..REL_18_STABLE.

apiCoverageVerification.result: Every inventory entry has an intended typed property or explicit output/utility/version binding; implementation audit must keep these bindings synchronized.

designDecisions.scope: Mutually exclusive globals/roles/tablespaces modes are represented by PgDumpAllScope rather than contradictory booleans.
designDecisions.connection: No public shared connection-options base is introduced because pg_dumpall --dbname semantics differ materially from pg_dump/pg_restore.
designDecisions.output: Dedicated PgDumpAllOutput separates stdout stream and file output.
designDecisions.nestedTool: The wrapper validates pg_dumpall itself; upstream then enforces the same-version sibling pg_dump invariant.
